subject: community-medicine
title: Food Poisoning: Incubation Clues and Outbreak Investigation

steps.title: The meal everyone shared
steps.tx: **Food poisoning** is acute gastroenteritis acquired from contaminated food or drink, typically striking a group who shared a meal within a characteristic incubation window. The shared exposure plus timetable is the diagnostic engine: list who ate what and when illness began, and the organism often names itself before any stool result returns.
steps.say: Shared meal, grouped illness, clock running. Food histories and onset times name organisms faster than laboratories. Start with the menu and the seating list.

steps.tx: **Food poisoning** is acute gastroenteritis caught from contaminated food or drink, usually in a group that shared one meal, inside an incubation window typical of the organism. The diagnostic engine is that shared exposure plus the clock. Listing who ate which dish and when each person fell ill often names the agent before any stool culture returns. A wedding counter of food held warm is the exposure list that this kind of investigation starts from.
steps.say: A group that shared one meal and then fell ill on a characteristic clock has food poisoning until the menu says otherwise. Who ate what, and when symptoms started, often names the organism before stool results. Warm held wedding food is the first exposure list.

vis.alt: Serving counters at a wedding hold cooked dishes that have been left at room temperature.
vis.caption: Cooked dishes sit at room temperature on wedding serving counters between rounds of guests. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.title: One to six hours: preformed toxin
steps.tx: **Staphylococcal food poisoning** erupts one to six hours after eating, with violent vomiting dominant, because Staphylococcus aureus toxin was already formed in the kept warm food and survives reheating. Bacillus cereus emetic type from reheated fried rice mirrors it. Antibiotics are useless; support and fluids carry the short, dramatic course.
steps.say: Vomiting within six hours means toxin preformed in the food. Staph in kept dishes, cereus in reheated rice. Reheating cannot save food already poisoned.

steps.title: Six to seventy two hours: living organisms
steps.tx: **Salmonella and Campylobacter** illnesses incubate longer, roughly six to seventy two hours, with fever, cramps and diarrhoea dominant as organisms invade or inflame the gut after ingestion. Eggs, poultry, unpasteurised milk and cross contaminated boards recur in histories. Most cases need fluids alone; antibiotics reserve for invasive or high risk disease.
steps.say: Longer incubation with fever and cramps means living organisms at work. Ask eggs, poultry, raw milk. Fluids treat most; antibiotics wait for invasion.

steps.title: Botulism: the neurological outlier
steps.tx: **Botulism** breaks the gastroenteritis pattern: home preserved low acid foods deliver toxin that causes descending symmetrical paralysis with dry mouth, double vision, dysphagia and respiratory failure, often with little fever or diarrhoea. It is a public health emergency needing antitoxin, airway readiness and immediate notification, never a watch and wait diagnosis.
steps.say: Descending paralysis, dry mouth, double vision after home preserves: botulism until proven otherwise. Antitoxin, airway, notify today. This one never waits.

steps.title: Food specific attack rates
steps.tx: The **attack rate table** cross tabulates illness against each food item eaten or skipped, and the item with high illness among eaters and near zero among non eaters accuses itself. Dose response, more eaten more ill, strengthens the charge. This two by two arithmetic is the beating heart of every outbreak report.
steps.say: Ill among eaters, well among skippers, sicker with bigger helpings. That arithmetic accuses a dish before cultures return. Build the table at the first visit.

steps.tx: The **attack rate table** crosses illness with each food, eaten or skipped. The dish that shows high illness among people who ate it and almost none among people who skipped it accuses itself. A dose response, more of that dish eaten and more illness, strengthens the charge. This two by two arithmetic is the centre of an outbreak report and can be built at the first site visit, before cultures have even been requested. The table, not the laboratory slip, is what points at the counter.
steps.say: For each dish, compare how many eaters fell ill with how many people who skipped it stayed well. A food with illness only among eaters, worse with larger portions, is the likely source. Build that table on the first visit, before cultures return.

vis.alt: An investigator fills a table of food specific attack rates, comparing illness in people who ate each dish with illness in people who skipped it.
vis.caption: A food specific attack rate table compares illness among people who ate each dish and people who did not. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.title: Samples before the clean up
steps.tx: **Sample discipline** decides whether laboratories can confirm the table's accusation: refrigerate leftover food, collect stool and vomitus from early cases, note batch and purchase details for commercial items, and stop further sale or service of suspect stock. Well meant kitchen clean ups destroy more outbreak evidence than any delay in testing.
steps.say: Refrigerate leftovers, sample early cases, freeze the suspect stock from sale. Evidence first, clean up second. Kitchens scrub away proof with the best intentions.

steps.title: Chemical and natural food toxins
steps.tx: **Non bacterial causes** widen the differential: mushroom toxins with delayed liver failure, scombroid histamine flushing from spoiled fish within minutes, heavy metals leaching into acidic drinks from vessels, pesticide contamination, and plant toxins such as argemone in mustard oil causing epidemic dropsy. A negative stool culture never closes an investigation alone.
steps.say: Minutes and flushing mean scombroid; days and jaundice after mushrooms mean hepatotoxins; dropsy points to argemone oil. Negative cultures leave chemistry unanswered.

steps.title: Prevention in kitchens that feed crowds
steps.tx: **Food safety discipline** for mass cooking rests on cook thoroughly, serve hot or refrigerate fast, separate raw and cooked, wash hands and boards, and exclude ill food handlers. The two hour room temperature rule for cooked food, rapid cooling in shallow trays and reheating to steaming throughout prevent the toxin forming head start.
steps.say: Hot held hot, cold held cold, raw away from cooked, ill handlers sent home. Two hours at room temperature is the toxin clock ticking.

steps.title: Notification and the report that prevents seconds
steps.tx: **Outbreak reporting** moves the same day to food safety and public health authorities when a commercial premises, institution kitchen or public event is implicated, because the next service repeats the exposure. The written report preserves the attack rate table, samples taken, control measures and handler exclusions, closing only after a symptom free interval passes.
steps.say: Commercial kitchen implicated means same day notification; tomorrow's service is the second outbreak. Write the table, the samples, the exclusions. Close after silence.
